data.name: Wok This Way!
data.detailed_description:
Suit up as a leaf sheep and blast your way through a chaotic 4v4 team shooter set on the Central Kitchen Carrier, a kitchen ship adrift in space where every ingredient on board has been mutated by cosmic rays into something wonderful and terrible!

Grab your Suction Gun and vacuum up mutated ingredients scattered across the arena. Here's the twist: every ingredient you pick up is a weapon, a skill, AND a cooking resource all at once. Fire bouncy jelly at your enemies or save it to heal your team. Launch a cookie shuriken through three opponents or toss it in the pot. The choice is yours, it's always a trade-off, and you never have enough.

Cook a recipe with your team, then push the pot across the arena and into the mouth of the Mobius Whoops Monster, a massive creature that showed up, ate everything on board, and now expects dinner service forever. The other team is racing to feed it too. First team to the Monster's mouth wins!

THROW, SHOOT, COOK, PUSH

Every match plays out in two wild phases:

Phase 1: Ingredient Frenzy! Both teams scramble to vacuum up ingredients and fight over the same supply. Use them as weapons to blast the other team, activate their skills for combat advantages, or toss them into the pot to complete the recipe. Every ingredient you fire is one you can't cook. Every ingredient you cook is one you can't fire. Choose wisely. Or don't. It's chaos either way.

Phase 2: Pot Push! Recipe done! One player becomes the Chef Leader, tethered to the pot. Now drag it across the arena into the Monster's mouth while your team protects you and the other team does everything in their power to stop you. The conveyor belt is spinning. Someone flipped the sun. A coconut geyser just launched four people into the ceiling. The pot is stuck on a corner. The Monster is waiting. GO.

TWO FORMS, ONE LEAF SHEEP

Switch between Humanoid Form and Leaf Sheep Form anytime!

In Humanoid Form you fight, shoot, vacuum up ingredients, cook, and push the pot. This is where the action is.

In Leaf Sheep Form you're tiny, fast, and can squeeze through gaps. Stand in sunlight and you photosynthesize to regenerate health! You can't fight in this form, but you can run, heal, and revive teammates by sharing chlorophyll. Know when to fight and when to be a small glowing plant. It matters more than you think.

ONE WILD ARENA

The Central Kitchen Carrier is your battlefield! A sushi conveyor belt rings the center, and it hasn't stopped spinning in four thousand cycles. Ride it, fight on it, use it to move your pot or mess with theirs. Flip the switch to reverse the belt AND the sun!

Half the map is lit. Half is dark. Leaf sheep regenerate in sunlight. Ambushes happen in shadow. Cotton candy platforms burst in a puff of pink sugar smoke the second you touch them. The floors are crooked because the builders got food poisoned during construction. The Mobius Whoops Monster sits in the center and waits.

FEATURES

  • 4v4 team-based multiplayer matches

  • 7 mutated ingredients with unique weapons and skills

  • Suction Gun for vacuuming up ingredients on the fly

  • Every ingredient is a weapon, a skill, and a recipe resource

  • Two-phase matches: ingredient combat into pot-pushing chaos

  • Dual form system: fight as a humanoid or heal as a leaf sheep

  • Dynamic arena with sushi conveyor belt, rotating sun, and destructible cotton candy platforms

  • 3–5 minute rounds that peak in a frantic race to feed the Monster

data.short_description: Grab your Suction Gun and fight as a leaf sheep in this wild 4v4 multiplayer shooter! Cosmic rays mutated every ingredient on the ship into something dangerous. Weaponize them, cook them into recipes, and push the pot into the Mobius Whoops Monster's mouth before the other team feeds it first.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 6600 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
